name: Mesa

queries.query: Mesa Arizona official parcel map GIS parcel polygons City of Mesa Data Hub public API
queries.scope: Find the city-maintained parcel layer, safe ID fields, and anonymous full-geometry route.
queries.result: The City of Mesa Data Hub describes current parcel polygons within Mesa and monthly reconciliation with county assessor parcel numbers. Its previously documented municipal GIS host reset in this environment. A separately published public ArcGIS Online service owned by the City GIS organization was queried directly and returned complete Polygon features with only OBJECTID/APN. The WUP center point itself returned no parcel; an adjacent 13-cell parcel-covered core sample about 1.1 km north qualified through the existing adapter.
queries.executionMethod: English-language research and anonymous HTTPS ArcGIS REST metadata/query requests. The alternate service was read using only OBJECTID, APN, and full geometry; no owner/address fields were requested. Existing adapter checks and independent GEOS QA are recorded in the adjacent acceptance and quality files.

queries.query: City of Mesa GIS public parcel map official polygon dataset APN
queries.scope: Cross-check city-local data ownership, currentness, and geometry format.
queries.result: City Data Hub describes current city parcel polygons reconciled monthly with county assessor parcel numbers. The independently reachable City GIS ArcGIS Online service returned complete polygons using only OBJECTID/APN; the direct municipal host reset before an HTTP response.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English-language search and first-party City of Mesa metadata inspection.

queries.query: Mesa Arizona public ArcGIS Online parcels ITDGIS FeatureServer
queries.scope: Find an independently reachable City GIS publisher for the public parcel layer.
queries.result: ArcGIS Online service root and layer 0 returned HTTP 200 directly. Layer 0 is a polygon feature layer in EPSG:2868, with OBJECTID and APN safe ID fields, query capability, maxRecordCount 2000, and a city-area extent. Total public service count was 201,714. Direct WUP point query returned zero features; a 2 km local envelope returned 43 complete Polygon features.
queries.executionMethod: Anonymous HTTPS GET; exact WUP center and bounded nearby envelope tested with geometry enabled and outFields=OBJECTID,APN.

verifiedParcelResponse.note: Exact WUP center returned a valid HTTP 200 empty FeatureCollection. A nearby 13-cell core grid approximately 1.1 km north returned 23 unique complete Polygon features with safe OBJECTID/APN only; three trimmed features are retained. Existing adapter 13-cell, forced paging, exact-ID refresh, explicit absence, footprint, and source-binding checks passed. Independent GEOS QA found all 23 valid, no duplicates, and no positive-area overlaps in this sample.

source.operator: Mesa City GIS organization (ArcGIS Online owner ITDGIS)
source.coordinateReferenceSystem: EPSG:2868; full feature queries returned GeoJSON in EPSG:4326
source.name: City of Mesa GIS parcel boundaries
source.scope: 23 valid, distinct City of Mesa-hosted parcel polygons verified in thirteen bounded cells around [33.3793,-111.8075], approximately 1.1 km north of the unchanged ranked WUP locator. The WUP point returned an explicit empty collection. Complete object-ID manifests, forced three-row paging, all 23 fresh APN geometry reads, explicit absence, footprint and binding passed. Independent GEOS audit in EPSG:32612 found no invalid geometries, duplicates, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The app starts at the tested nearby parcel-covered reference; citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy and APN uniqueness outside this sample are unverified.
